item.title: I still prefer MCP over skills
item.description:
📝 I just don’t like Skills. Pure knowledge skills work in Claude, but most others don’t. Context Bloat: Using a skill often requires loading the entire SKILL.

item.title: We've raised $17M to build what comes after Git
item.description:
📝 Announcing the GitButler CLI for LinuxThis monthby Simon Larsén3 min readIn early February, we announced But, the GitButler CLI. The announcement had one glaring flaw: Linux was never mentioned. We're rectifying that now, because But loves Linux, and Linux will come to love But.
🔗 Read more: https://blog.gitbutler.com/series-a
